prompt:
In 1856, scientist Eunice Newton Foote conducted experiments showing that carbon dioxide could trap heat more effectively than ordinary air. Although her work received limited attention at the time, later scholars have recognized it as an early contribution to climate science. Foote’s experiment is now often described as ______ because it anticipated questions scientists continue to study today.
Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word?
explanation: Foote’s experiment was an early contribution that anticipated later climate science questions, so “pioneering” is most precise.

prompt:
Some plants rely on ants to spread their seeds. These plants produce seeds with small food-rich parts that ants carry back to their nests. After eating the food-rich parts, the ants leave the seeds underground, where the seeds may be protected until they sprout.
Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

choices.A: Some ants help plants reproduce by carrying and burying seeds.
choices.B: Ants prevent all plant seeds from growing underground.
choices.C: Plants that rely on ants do not produce seeds with food-rich parts.
choices.D: Seeds can sprout only after ants remove them from the soil.

explanation: The passage explains that ants carry seeds, eat the food-rich parts, and leave the seeds underground where they may sprout.

prompt:

choices.B: The Healthy snacks workshop had more students than the Public speaking workshop.
choices.C: The Study skills and Public speaking workshops had the same attendance.
choices.D: No workshop had more than 29 students attend.

prompt:
Rosa wanted her first printmaking project to show a perfect row of trees. When the ink spread unevenly, she almost threw the paper away. Her teacher suggested looking at the print again. Rosa noticed that the uneven ink made the trees seem to move in the wind, so she decided to keep the image.
Which choice best describes what happens in the text?

choices.A: Rosa learns to see value in an unexpected result.
choices.B: Rosa stops working on printmaking because she dislikes ink.
choices.C: Rosa proves that careful planning always prevents mistakes.
choices.D: Rosa teaches her teacher how to print a row of trees.

explanation: Rosa first thinks the uneven ink ruined the print but then decides it makes the trees seem to move.

prompt:
In a passage about medieval town bells, a historian explains that bells were rung for many reasons, including fires, market openings, and curfews. The historian adds, “Because many residents could not read posted announcements, the sound of a bell could quickly spread important information.”

choices.B: It argues that medieval towns did not have markets.
choices.C: It describes how bells were made from metal.
choices.D: It shows that posted announcements were always louder than bells.

explanation: The quoted sentence explains that bells could spread important information quickly to residents who could not read announcements.

prompt:

prompt:

choices.C: It prevents predators from living near the shore.
choices.D: It makes them grow faster than all other marine animals.
